besluite.rede: 'Nie meer soos haarself lyk nie' is acceptable Afrikaans and reports what Mia sees; 'nie meer haarself is nie' turns her observation into a flat claim, so the meaning moves.
The paired 'hard ... hard' reads as deliberate story rhythm (changing the first one was already rejected), and 'toegeslaan' drops the sound the original describes.

besluite.fout: An indefinite subject after the inverted verb without existential 'daar' reads stiff.
besluite.rede: 'Het daar bokse ... gestaan' is the natural Afrikaans construction and changes nothing in the meaning.

besluite.fout: 'Geskop' with no object sounds clipped and can read as kicking the lawn itself.
besluite.rede: 'Bal geskop' finishes the expression from the previous sentence and adds no new information.
'In wiskunde' is normal school Afrikaans; the proposal is longer and only reads differently.
'Tot die einde geluister' is already correct and natural; adding 'toe' is a lateral move.
